Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into the fuzzer buffer before parsing."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":789,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The fuzz entry point passes the copied buffer to the config parser as a non-NUL-terminated byte range."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":805,"var":"lexer.end","code":".end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer end pointer is set from the attacker-controlled length, so later pointer arithmetic can reach the exact end of input."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":323,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (chr == '\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, "''", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;","note":"A leading single quote sequence selects multiline-string lexing when the input begins with three quotes."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":346,"var":"end","code":"char *end = (peek(lexer) == '"') ? "\"\"\"" : "'''";","note":"The lexer decides the closing delimiter based on the attacker-controlled third quote and then scans for that delimiter."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":349,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) {","note":"The loop probes three bytes at lexer->pos without first ensuring three bytes remain, so a short unterminated triple-quoted string can drive an out-of-bounds read past the mapped input."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]')
print(p.read_text())
PY
